title: ADscan PRO licence status v1
description: The output of `adscan license status --json` (alias `adscan license show --json`): may this machine start a new assessment under its PRO licence, and what the operator is told. Two dates are kept apart. contract_ends_on is the CONTRACT: the grant's last day, which ADscan may extend; null with contract_term open_ended means the contract has no end date, null with contract_term unknown means an older licence document did not state it. document_valid_until is the DOCUMENT: how long this machine may work without checking in with the licence server (the grant's maximum offline days); an online launch refreshes it on its own. scans_allowed is the decision; state, notice_level and message explain it. Written by one writer (status_document in adscan_core/pro_license/status_view.py). Version marker: schema_version, '1.<minor>'. Declared objects may gain fields within a major; do not reject unknown keys.

required.$comment: False while enforcement is dormant (no licensed-build marker and no licence installed).

days_remaining.$comment: Days the current document (or its grace) still allows new assessments.

contract_term.$comment: null when no licence is installed.

renews_automatically.$comment: True when online launches refresh the document (false under offline mode and for an offline engagement licence).

last_refreshed_at.$comment: When the licence server signed the document this machine holds.

last_check_in_at.$comment: The last answer this machine received from the licence server.

last_check_in_result.$comment: current, refreshed, revoked, notice, unreachable or rejected.

last_contact.$comment: Same instant as last_check_in_at; kept for readers of the first status output.

licence_notice.$comment: Since 1.1. What the licence needs from the licence server; null when it answered and nothing is pending or ending.

valid_until.$comment: The document's last day (same value as document_valid_until).

licence_notice.$comment: Written by adscan_core/pro_license/connection.py (LicenceNotice.to_dict). The same block in license_status, license_check and the licence_notice event; tests/unit/contracts/test_licence_notice_contract.py keeps the three copies identical. Present only when the licence server was not reached at the latest check-in, a domain is waiting to be registered, or the contract end is near.

server_reached.$comment: Whether the licence server answered the latest check-in (this launch's when one ran).

check_in_result.$comment: current, refreshed, notice, revoked, rejected or unreachable.

unreachable_since.$comment: First failed check-in of the current run of failures.

works_offline_until.$comment: Last day new assessments can start on this machine without reaching the licence server (document end plus its grace).

assessment_allowed_until.$comment: Last day a new assessment of this domain may start without registering it; null when it never blocks.
